def test_anti_shuffle():
    assert anti_shuffle("Hello World") == "Hello Wdlor"   # per-word sort, ASCII order
    assert anti_shuffle("cba") == "abc"                   # single word
    assert anti_shuffle("") == ""                         # empty input
    assert anti_shuffle("b  a") == "b  a"                 # consecutive spaces preserved
    assert anti_shuffle("b1a!") == "!1ab"                 # digits/punctuation sort by ASCII
    assert anti_shuffle("bA") == "Ab"                     # uppercase before lowercase
    assert anti_shuffle("dc ba") == "cd ab"               # word order unchanged
